name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.volume_thickening_ball_le_cost
statement:
theorem volume_thickening_ball_le_cost {n : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)

    (hr : δ / 2 ≤ r) (hrδ : r ≤ δ) :
    volume (thickening δ (ball x r)) ≤
      (volume (ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) *
        ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ s)) *

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.volume_thickening_ball_union_le_cost

    volume (thickening δ (⋃ i ∈ I, ball (x i) (r i))) ≤
      (volume (ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) *
        ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ s)) *

theorem plateAverage_rotate (u : Rotations n) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))

name: NKBesicovitch.exists_interpolated_series_constant
statement:

    (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ (V : ℝ≥0∞) (N : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ≥0∞),
      (∀ j l, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j / 2) * N j l ≤
        C ^ (θ / q) * V ^ (β * θ / q) * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j / 2) ^ (1 - θ) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (B * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ l) ^ ((β - 1) * (1 - θ) / q) *
            S ^ ((1 - θ) / q)) →
      (∑' j : ℕ, ∑' l : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) * N j l) ≤

statement:

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.cornerReservoir_spec
statement:
theorem cornerReservoir_spec {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1)

    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) :
    MeasurableSet (cornerReservoir I a b c δ) ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 3 / 160000) ≤
        volume (cornerReservoir I a b c δ) ∧
      ∀ κ ∈ cornerReservoir I a b c δ, κ ≠ 0 ∧
        δ * ((volume I).toReal / 100) ^ 2 ≤ |κ| ∧ |κ| ≤ (100 / (volume I).toReal) ^ 3 ∧
        MeasurableSet (cornerOuterTimes I a b c δ κ) ∧ cornerOuterTimes I a b c δ κ ⊆ I ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 7 / 320000000000) ≤
          volume (cornerOuterTimes I a b c δ κ) ∧

          ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 5 / 8000000) ≤
            volume (dualTimes I b a (cornerInnerCoefficient a c κ u))

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.inner_controlCoefficient_eq
statement:
theorem inner_controlCoefficient_eq (m : ℕ) (β : ℝ) {r C : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hC : 0 < C) :
    (2 * r⁻¹ ^ m * C) ^ (1 / (β - 1)) / (r ^ m) ^ (β / (β - 1)) =
      controlCoefficient m β r C

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.outer_controlCoefficient_eq

    ((2 * (r⁻¹ ^ m) ^ 2 * C) * (r⁻¹ ^ m) ^ (β - 1)) ^ (1 / (β - 1)) =
      controlCoefficient m β r C

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.codeDensity_eq_lintegral
statement:
theorem codeDensity_eq_lintegral (a b c : ℝ) {W : Set (PairCoordinates m)}
    (hW : MeasurableSet W) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    codeDensity a b c W z = codeJacobian m a b *
      ∫⁻ g, W.indicator 1 (pairFromCode a b c g z)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.lintegral_codeDensity
statement:
theorem lintegral_codeDensity {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (c : ℝ)
    {W : Set (PairCoordinates m)} (hW : MeasurableSet W) :
    (∫⁻ z, codeDensity a b c W z) = volume W

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.measurable_codeDensity
statement:
theorem measurable_codeDensity (a b c : ℝ) {W : Set (PairCoordinates m)}
    (hW : MeasurableSet W) : Measurable (codeDensity a b c W)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.codeDensity_eq_marginal
statement:
theorem codeDensity_eq_marginal {a b c t : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hta : t ≠ a) (htb : t ≠ b) {W : Set (PairCoordinates m)} (hW : MeasurableSet W)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    codeDensity a b c W z =
      ENNReal.ofReal |(((b - a) / (dualTime a b c t - a)) ^ m)⁻¹| *
        ∫⁻ y, pairDensity a t (dualTime a b c t) W
          (y, ((b - a) / (dualTime a b c t - a))⁻¹ •
            (z - (c * (b - a) / (t - a)) • y))

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.codeDensity_eq_twoSlice_lintegral
statement:
theorem codeDensity_eq_twoSlice_lintegral {a b t : ℝ} (hta : t ≠ a)
    (c : ℝ) {W : Set (PairCoordinates m)} (hW : MeasurableSet W) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    codeDensity a b c W z =
      (codeJacobian m a b * ENNReal.ofReal |((t - a) ^ m)⁻¹|) *
        ∫⁻ y, ∫⁻ w, W.indicator 1
          (pairFromCode a b c (lineAt a w ((t - a)⁻¹ • (y - w))) z)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.codeJacobian_dual

theorem codeJacobian_dual {a b c t : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hta : t ≠ a) (htb : t ≠ b) :
    ENNReal.ofReal |(((b - a) / (dualTime a b c t - a)) ^ m)⁻¹| *
      ENNReal.ofReal |((dualTime a b c t - a) ^ m)⁻¹| = codeJacobian m a b

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.lineAt_twoSlice
statement:
theorem lineAt_twoSlice {a t : ℝ} (hta : t ≠ a) (g : Line m) :
    lineAt a (atHeight a g) ((t - a)⁻¹ • (atHeight t g - atHeight a g)) = g

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.pairCode_pairFromData_dual
statement:
theorem pairCode_pairFromData_dual {a b c t : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hta : t ≠ a) (htb : t ≠ b) (w y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    pairCode a b c (pairFromData a t (dualTime a b c t)
      (w, (y, ((b - a) / (dualTime a b c t - a))⁻¹ •
        (z - (c * (b - a) / (t - a)) • y)))) = z

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.pairFromData_dual_eq_pairFromCode
statement:
theorem pairFromData_dual_eq_pairFromCode {a b c t : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hta : t ≠ a) (htb : t ≠ b) (w y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    pairFromData a t (dualTime a b c t)
      (w, (y, ((b - a) / (dualTime a b c t - a))⁻¹ •
        (z - (c * (b - a) / (t - a)) • y))) =
      pairFromCode a b c (lineAt a w ((t - a)⁻¹ • (y - w))) z

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.pairProjections_pairFromCode_dual
statement:
theorem pairProjections_pairFromCode_dual {a b c t : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hta : t ≠ a) (htb : t ≠ b) (g : Line m) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    pairProjections a t (dualTime a b c t) (pairFromCode a b c g z) =
      (atHeight t g, ((b - a) / (dualTime a b c t - a))⁻¹ •
        (z - (c * (b - a) / (t - a)) • atHeight t g))

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.atHeight_lineAt_of_positions
statement:
theorem atHeight_lineAt_of_positions {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (w y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    atHeight b (lineAt a w ((b - a)⁻¹ • (y - w))) = y

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.codeDensity_eq_lintegral_codeSliceMass
statement:
theorem codeDensity_eq_lintegral_codeSliceMass {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (c : ℝ)
    {W : Set (PairCoordinates m)} (hW : MeasurableSet W) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.codeSliceMass_le_parallelFiber
statement:

    (z y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :

statement:
theorem second_pairFromCode_of_positions {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (c : ℝ)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.support_codeSliceMass_subset

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.codeDensity_le_parallelMultiplicity
statement:
theorem codeDensity_le_parallelMultiplicity {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hc : c ≠ 0)

    (hWG : W ⊆ pairFamily a G) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    codeDensity a b c W z ≤ codeJacobian m a b ^ 2 *

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.codeDensity_ne_top
statement:
theorem codeDensity_ne_top {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hc : c ≠ 0)

statement:
